info.description:
Listening:

Students can listen to understand a speaker’s main ideas, explanations and examples.

Students also listen to know strategies needed in academic situations such as listening for results, special terms, advantages and disadvantages, …

Students also listen to handle the information they hear by using such strategies as understanding cause and effect, event sequences, recognizing definitions, predicting, interpreting speaker’s attitude.

Speaking:

Students know how to express what they think and/or feel, and how to make themselves well understood by handling issues related to techniques or strategies used in daily speaking encounters.

Students are also able to use pronunciation strategies to express correctly what they want to say in everyday speaking situations.

Students also know how to speak correctly what is related to academic issues such as presentations, debates and self- introductions.
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of in-class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptops in class only for learning purposes

- Use CD-ROM provided with the textbook

- Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
